Class GameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.GameTestSupport
public final class GameTestSupport extends Object
NeoForge-native scaffolding for the GameTests: ResourceHandler capability access through Capabilities.Item.BLOCK, and the level's fake player. Everything loader-neutral lives in GameTestScaffold.
